results.title: HyMCache: A KV Cache Framework for Multi-Turn LLM Serving with CXL-Hybrid Memory
results.summary: Proposes HyMCache, a KV cache framework that integrates CXL-hybrid memory (in-device DRAM plus SSD-backed capacity behind a CXL interface) to serve multi-turn and agentic LLM workloads, using request-level prefix prefetching and write buffering to achieve 3.0x single-node speedup with 16x less DRAM.

results.title: SAC: Disaggregated KV Cache System for Sparse Attention LLMs with CXL
results.summary: Introduces SAC, the first disaggregated KV cache system for sparse-attention LLMs, exploiting CXL's low-latency cache-line granularity load/store memory semantics to fetch only active top-k KV entries on demand, achieving 2.1x throughput and 9.7x lower TTFT versus RDMA baselines on DeepSeek-V3.2.

results.title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
results.summary: Presents ITME, a tiered memory expansion system that exposes a massive TB-scale byte-addressable remote CXL-hybrid memory pool for LLM inference, validated on production SK Hynix CMM hardware and showing up to 35.7% throughput improvement by proactively managing data movement for model weights and prefix caches.

results.title: Distributed Persistence Domain for Persistent Memory Pooling
results.summary: Defines the Distributed Persistence Domain, a new abstraction that brings persistence semantics to CXL-based disaggregated memory pooling at the switch level, reducing persist latency and achieving an average 33% speedup over volatile CXL switches on SPLASH-4 and YCSB.

results.title: Breaking AI Memory Limits with CXL Memory Pooling
results.summary: Samsung's evaluation of CXL memory pooling (CMM-D modules through a CXL switch, 1TB pool) for offloading LLM KV cache, reporting near-DRAM performance (approximately 92% of DRAM at 8 GPUs) and stable throughput under growing KV cache demands where DRAM degraded.

results.title: Beluga: A CXL-Based Memory Architecture for Scalable and Efficient LLM KVCache Management
results.summary: Proposes Beluga, the first system letting GPUs directly access a large-scale shared memory pool through CXL switches using native load/store semantics over the CXL fabric; Beluga-KVCache achieves 89.6% TTFT reduction and 7.35x throughput versus RDMA in vLLM. Accepted at SIGMOD'26.

results.title: CXL-DMSim: A Full-System CXL Disaggregated Memory Simulator With Comprehensive Silicon Validation
results.summary: Presents CXL-DMSim, an open-source full-system simulator modeling CXL.io and CXL.mem protocol semantics for disaggregated memory, validated against FPGA and ASIC CXL hardware with 3.4% average simulation error; published in IEEE TCAD 2025 and integrated into the SimCXL GitHub project.
